messages:
alice: quick q — how should we bind quota slabs to SKUs for burst budgets? currently console shows slab ids but customers ask 'which plan gets which burst behavior'
ben: can you show the current mapping you have?
alice: pasted config snippet from the prototype: ```
slabs:
  - id: 0
    name: free-slab
    qps: 5
    burst_tokens: 50
  - id: 1
    name: pro-slab
    qps: 50
    burst_tokens: 1000
  - id: 2
    name: enterprise-slab
    qps: 500
    burst_tokens: 10000
bindings:
  free: slab:0 scope:per-key
  pro: slab:1 scope:per-org
  enterprise: slab:2 scope:per-org
```
carol: couple edgecases: 1) pro customers asked for per-key burst (api keys used by many subservices) so pro scope=per-org might be surprising 2) enterprise wants a shared reserved pool + per-key soft caps so they can carve sub-key quotas
dave: I think we need explicit precedence rules. Suggest: `per-key explicit` > `org reserved pool` > `plan default slab`. That way if a key has a custom entitlement, it wins.
ben: agree. Also need to clarify billing impact: burst_tokens consumed from org pool should be attributed to org billing, not the key owner, unless customer requested per-key billing.
alice: UI question — console should surface "effective slab" for a key and show contributing sources (plan, org pool, key override). otherwise support tickets keep asking why my key got throttled.
carol: yup. Also we should add an admin toggle: "enable org burst sharing" default true for enterprise, false for pro/free. Document in the rollout notes.
dave: telemetry impact — add tags: `quota_source:{plan|org_pool|key_override}`, `consumed_burst_tokens`, `throttle_reason`. This will let Optimize recommend changes per workload.
alice: does anyone object to this binding change (free->per-key, pro->per-org opt-in, enterprise->org-pool + key softcaps)?
ben: no objections. needs RFC and migration script to remap existing plan labels to slab ids for customers that relied on old behavior.
carol: note migration: for pro orgs that previously expected per-key, we should default to preserving existing effective behavior by creating per-key overrides during migration. Add to migration playbook.
infra-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/842 "slab-to-sku binding + migration" (assigned: carol) :white_check_mark:
alice: thanks — I'll draft RFC and include console wire showing effective-slab tooltip. action items: alice write RFC, carol migration plan, dave telemetry schema, ben billing attribution doc.
ben: +1 :thumbsup:
alice: will ping when RFC ready for review.
